E2.failure_mode_tested: Silent reassignment: dropped notes, renumbered or truncated chains, empty-note acceptance.

E4.failure_mode_tested: Gate erosion: direct finish, skipped review, self-review, wrong-role review, non-member review, stale approval reuse.
E4.title: Review gate: no DONE without human review

drill3_db_unreachable.note: Core connects once at startup (expect() on connect), so an unreachable DSN at boot kills the process before it can serve; this drill severs the database after boot, which is the reachable form of the same failure: assign must return OPERATIONAL and admit nothing.

failures_and_deviations: drill2 as specified: POST /principals/DH-002/suspend -> 404, POST /principals/DH-003/revoke -> 404 (expected 200). The core resolves the workspace with query_opt on principals.id alone; the id exists in many workspaces, so the lookup errors and returns 404 'principal not found'. Suspend/revoke is therefore unusable for roster ids shared across workspaces (the normal case). No mutation occurred (verified in probing).
